youtube.title: Why Is the Statue of Liberty Green? (She Used to Be Brown) #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The Statue of Liberty arrived in New York in 1886 a shiny coppery brown. Nobody painted her green: the sea air did, over about two decades. And when people wanted to paint over it, the green turned out to be the very thing protecting her.

From Bartholdi's copper sheets and Eiffel's iron frame to patina, corrosion and the 1906 plan to paint her: this is the hidden why behind the green Statue of Liberty.
